svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer dream crest refinements
svg.desc: Four native logo refinements based on the v1 Grand Tourer Crest: exact dream bubbles, a small red dream cloud, a sculpted GT car, and a white thought cloud enclosing the car. The original crest is shown as a reference.

g.text: Grand Tourer Crest / v3 / Dreams of the next drive
Based on the selected v1 crest. Navy shield, red crown and the Driver Dreamer wordmark carry forward.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Crest
svg.desc: An original deep navy shield holds a white, front-facing sports car with a low roof and distinctive split headlights. A red crown stripe and three red collection rows connect luxury vehicle discovery with an organized automotive database.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Dream Bubbles
svg.desc: An original deep navy shield holds a white, front-facing sports car with a low roof and distinctive split headlights. A red crown stripe and three outlined red thought bubbles that grow toward the car express the dream of a future drive.

text.tspan: Original crest; only the rows change.
Outlined bubbles grow toward the car.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Dream Cloud
svg.desc: The original deep navy shield, red crown stripe and white front-facing sports car remain unchanged. A small red outlined thought cloud beneath the car and two descending bubbles replace the collection rows, expressing the dream of driving.

text.tspan: Original crest with a scalloped cloud.
Two small bubbles complete the thought.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Sculpted Dream
svg.desc: The original softened navy Grand Tourer Crest is refined with a slim red crown and a lower, wider white grand tourer. Split headlights and a tapered intake sharpen the original generic vehicle silhouette. Three red thought bubbles grow diagonally upward toward the dream car.

text.tspan: Lower GT profile and a slimmer crown.
Filled bubbles follow a gentle diagonal.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Cloud Car
svg.desc: The original navy shield and red crown hold a white scalloped thought cloud surrounding a smaller original front-facing sports car. Two red outlined bubbles and a tiny red dot descend beneath the cloud, expressing a dream of driving.

text.tspan: A white dream cloud surrounds the car.
Red bubbles lead up into the dream.

g.text: Each direction includes an editable SVG lockup and icon, plus PNG previews. Concept 01 preserves the original visible artwork except the red rows.
